_note: Venue facts used on /events/ pages. Every entry comes from the venue's or operator's own page (see source), read on 2026-11-22. Add a venue here only with a source; an event whose venue is not listed gets a noindex page that stays out of the sitemap. A venue with "noindex": true shows its facts on the event page, but the page stays noindex because it has too little unique content to index.

Wilson Center at Cape Fear Community Col.parking: The venue's getting-here page lists the Hanover Student Parking Deck at 200 Hanover Street, open 1.5 hours before showtime, at $8 prepaid or $10 cash at the gate. Metered street parking is also available around the Wilson Center. Rates can change, so check the venue page before you go.

Cameron Art Museum.parking: The museum's visit page does not describe parking. Call the museum at (910) 395-5999 to ask before you go.
Cameron Art Museum.hours: The museum lists hours of 10 AM to 5 PM Tuesday through Sunday, open until 9 PM on Wednesdays and Thursdays, and closed Mondays.

Ocean Front Park and Pavilion.parking: The town says parking is available in any marked public space, subject to paid parking enforcement during season.

Carolina Beach Lake Park.parking: The park listing does not describe parking. The Town of Carolina Beach publishes its parking rules at carolinabeach.org/visitors/parking.
Carolina Beach Lake Park.about: The park has an 11-acre lake, four gazebos, a playground and a picnic area.

Kenan Auditorium.parking: UNCW lists free on-site parking for Kenan Auditorium events.

Burgwin-Wright House and Gardens.parking: The museum's website does not describe parking, so ask the organizer before you go.

Battleship North Carolina.parking: The ticketing page points visitors to the Parking section of battleshipnc.com for current details.
Battleship North Carolina.area_note: The ship is moored across the Cape Fear River from downtown.
Battleship North Carolina.about: The World War II battleship is open for self-guided tours.

Airlie Gardens.parking: Airlie's visit page says a ticket includes parking and access to the grounds all day.

Children's Museum of Wilmington.parking: The museum has a separate directions and parking page on its website. The main entrance is on Orange Street, and a stroller and wheelchair accessible entrance is on 2nd Street.

Carolina Beach State Park.address: 1010 State Park Road, Carolina Beach, NC 28428
Carolina Beach State Park.parking: NC State Parks lists no fee for most day-use activities, including hiking, biking and fishing, and says accessible parking is provided. A $7 fee applies to the boat launch.
